Born at Weybridge, Vermont, 21 February 1808, son of Constant Southworth and Ruth Peckham,
who moved on from Weybridge to Bangor. He married Nancy Hunter on 20 February 1833 and farmed at Bangor,
Franklin County, New York, where every census from 1840 to 1875 finds him; in 1850 he and Nancy had five children
at home, Moses, Egbert, Francis, Mary and Norman.
Norman later went west to Palouse, Washington, where he died in 1919.
Francis died at Bangor on 18 July 1875 and is buried in the Southworth Cemetery there.
Born in Vermont on 22 December 1808, by the family history.
She married Francis Southworth on 20 February 1833, and the censuses from 1850 to 1875 find them farming at Bangor,
Franklin County, New York, where she raised five children, among them Moses.
She died on 18 August 1880, aged 71, and is buried in the Southworth Cemetery at Bangor.
Her parents are not yet found.
